sloka: ततो ऽयोन्यं सुसंरब्धावुभौ तौ रामरावणौ ।शरान्धकारे समरे नोपालक्षयतां तदा ।। ६.१०५.९ ।।
transliteration: tato 'yonyaṁ susaṁrabdhāvubhau tau rāmarāvaṇau ।śarāndhakāre samare nopālakṣayatāṁ tadā ।। 6.105.9 ।।

translations.english: Then with both Rama and Ravana speedily releasing (hail of) arrows on one another, the battlefield was darkened by arrows, and they were not able to see each other.
